transcript.text: Welcome to On Print Shop.
In this video we'll walk you through the powerful document print product type designed to simplify bulk and multi page document printing for your customers.
Whether they need to print business reports, training manuals, assignments or internal documents, this new product type offers a streamlined and professional experience.
Let's start by understanding how Document Print works.
With this set up, customers can directly upload documents such as PDFs or Word files at the time of placing an order.
Once the file is uploaded, the system automatically reads important details like the total number of pages, helping to instantly calculate pricing based on your configured rules.
This eliminates the need for manual page entry, ensuring greater accuracy and a faster checkout experience.
Customers will also see a real time document preview after upload, allowing them to review their file before proceeding.

They can customize print options such as single sided or double sided printing, black and white or color output, paper types, binding methods and finishing services, all configured by the admin to match different business needs.
Another exciting feature is the ability to add number and colour tabs for better document navigation.
Customers can insert tabs within the document by selecting specific page breaks, choosing a colour for the tab and assigning a number or label to it.
These tabs act as dividers and make printed documents easier to organize and browse, especially for large reports, manuals or multi section booklets.
This enhances customer experience by offering greater personalisation and professional level finishing options.
Another powerful feature for document print products is the ability to add customized cover options.
Customers can either upload their own cover file or choose from colour and image based covers.
With the upload option, the system automatically identifies the cover layout based on the number of pages.
One page for a front cover, 2 pages for front and back covers and four pages for a complete set including front cover, inner pages and back cover.
Alternatively, with colour or image covers, customers can pick a cover colour from the options provided by the admin or choose a pattern type cover for front and back covers.
This flexibility gives customers more control over the appearance of their printed documents, helping them create reports, manuals or booklets that feel personalized and high quality.
Now let's discuss how to set this up from the admin side.
To create a Document Print product, go to your Product Management section and select Document Print as the product type.
You'll then configure size settings, upload rules, tab options, and pricing formulas.
Pricing can be flexibly set based on attributes like the number of pages, color preferences, binding options, and additional finishing like tabs.
Additionally, you can configure Studio events for Document Print products to deliver a more dynamic and interactive ordering experience.
Studio events let you link specific product options to real time actions within the designer studio.
For example, if a customer selects A portrait orientation, you can bind this choice to a studio event that updates the documents layout and preview accordingly.
For cover options, you can link color attributes directly to events.
For instance, if a customer chooses green for the cover, you can bind it to the front and back cover event, pick the exact shade from the color picker, set the opacity, and apply it.

In the same way, you can bind other options like size, paper type, finishing preferences, or cover options to their respective events, allowing customers to instantly see and adjust their printing selections.

Once your product is published, customers can seamlessly navigate to the document print page, upload their file, select printing preferences, add tabs for easier navigation, and place their order, all in just a few intuitive steps.
Thank you for watching.
If you need any assistance setting up document print products or configuring Studio events, feel free to reach out to our support team via live chat on on printshop.com.
Thanks for tuning in.
